originStory.title: Why Knowii Exists
originStory.subtitle: More than knowledge management; a structured system for doing good work.
originStory.story: I created Knowii because the systems I've built have enabled me to cope with everything life threw at me: a failed startup that cost **200k€** and two years of my life. Crushing shyness that made me terrified of communication. The painful transition from introverted engineer to leader and manager. **Burnout** from trying to do everything through willpower. Losing loved ones and questioning what matters. Raising **three kids** while building a business and creating content alongside a demanding corporate career. Through all of this, I realized that information overload was just one symptom of a deeper problem. What I needed, what we all need, is a **structured system** for clarity, learning, organization, and execution, PLUS the AI skills to amplify everything. That's what Knowii delivers: a **community of practice** where we share Knowledge Management techniques, AI skills, and the full toolkit for doing good work.
originStory.inspirationPoint: Knowledge management is the foundation. AI skills are the accelerator. Together, they create a real edge.

creatorJourney.title: 20+ Years Building Systems
creatorJourney.subtitle: Not just theory; battle-tested systems I use daily.
creatorJourney.story: I've been coding since age 8 and writing almost as long. In my IT career, I've been a software developer, technical lead, software architect, solution architect, infrastructure architect, IT security expert, team leader, project manager, CTO, and founder. Today, I work half-time as an IT Solution Architect for a major financial organization while running DeveloPassion, raising 3 kids, and maintaining nearly **10,000 notes** in my personal knowledge system. I've published **3 books**, written **400+ articles** and newsletters, created courses, and built products used by thousands. When AI exploded, I dove deep. I built systems for AI ghostwriting, MCP integration, and workflows that produce useful output. The Knowii Community is where I share ALL of it: Knowledge Management + AI + a framework for working smarter.
